title: _artifact
description: An output of a task, such as a document, source code or a pull request, or of a work: the note in which its approver explains the decision. It either embeds the output or refers to it where it is stored. Draft v0.

task.description: The task the artifact is the output of. Set for an artifact of a task, null for an artifact of a work.

work.description: The work the artifact belongs to: the note of its approver, written before the decision. Set for an artifact of a work, null for an artifact of a task.

version.description: Separate counter per task or per work (scoped by the id of the one that is set). Human-readable form is `task-<task id>-artifact-<version>` or `work-<work id>-artifact-<version>`, e.g. `task-1-artifact-1`, `work-1-artifact-1`.

ref.description: Where the output is stored: a path, a URL or another reference.
